🎗️Feedback from Our Lords: September 2026
Updates🎗️
🎗️Thanks for being an awesome part of our
community!
🎗️ Check Out the Full Details Here:
1. The Guild Honor Store offers Soul Stones from all
three factions: Horde, Nature, and League.
2. After unlocking a Troop Skin, you can now view its
max-level stats and easily compare them with its
current stats.
3. More Castle Skins, March Skins, and Castle Auras
are now available on the Gold Block Website.
4. Optimized and improved the Hero Level Sources.
5. Increased the refresh rate of Pet Food-related
Quests.
6. Increased the Ranking Rewards for Tier B and
above
7. Optimized the construction rules for PhantomPal
Camps: PhantomPal Camps can now be placed freely.
8. Optimized the Military Hall: Added a Facility
Details display
9. Adjusted the Genesis Castle: A 2-hour cooldown is
now applied when changing the footprint size of a
max-star Genesis Castle on the World Map.
10. [CLOUDSEA ODYSSEY]Increased the maximum
damage a Lv.14 Guild Boss can take in a single
battle.
11. Increased the storage capacity of the Guild Ruby
Mine, making it easier for Lords to gather resources.
12. The PhantomPal Arena timer now counts down to
the next Ranking settlement instead of the end of the
event.
13. Updated the Chat input bar to keep the Lord's
entered message instead of clearing it when a Chat
cooldown is triggered.
14. Added a special watermark to King's Mail. A
special reminder will also appear when receiving
King's Mail.
15. Added a Do Not Disturb feature for mail stack
groups.
